page.content:
Snorri Sturluson's handbook that retells the myths in prose.

How Prose Edda connects

  • Character: Snorri Sturluson — Snorri compiled the Prose Edda.
  • Work: Poetic Edda — Snorri's handbook retells and organizes the older eddic poems.

What is Prose Edda?

The Prose Edda, written in thirteenth-century Iceland, organizes the gods, kennings, and Ragnarok narrative that later readers treat as a continuous story.

Key threads lead to Snorri Sturluson and Poetic Edda.
